footer.slogan: A platform where imagination becomes stories

lyrics.title: Your imagination has no limits. Your story has no rules.
lyrics.subtitle: Sign up and create your own fanfic world with AI: new plots, unexpected twists, favorite characters — exactly how you want.
lyrics.text: Every idea comes alive here. Start writing your legend today.

invocations.l:
Support the content you truly enjoy.
Find stories that captivate you and support the creators with likes. This way you help the best works rise higher and the creators get motivated to create even more interesting content.
invocations.c:
Create amazing content and bring ideas to life.
Write fanfiction, invent new stories, create your own worlds and characters. Our platform will help you easily format the text, add emotions to the story and share your creativity with other readers.
invocations.s:
Share moments and ideas with the world.
Share your favorite stories with friends and the community. Expand your creativity, discover new authors, and help great stories find their readers.

errors.fillAllFields: Please fill all fields and add at least one character.
errors.mustBeLoggedIn: You must be logged in to create a story.
